acceptance: #2797's description states the Bot-only default and why
#2784's 300-file statement is corrected (or the item oracle-marker-patch-map-file-limit-20261009 records the correction)
context: Found in the completion audit of the oracle replacement on 2026-10-09. Editing a merged PR's title or body is a GitHub write the owner approves.
description:
PR descriptions are the durable record readers search later. Two merged ones are wrong:
- #2797 says the follow-up sweep defaults `DEFAULT_REVIEW_AUTHORS` to `benchbox-oracle[bot]` and `benchbox-oracle`. Its second commit (881873c51, "trust only the oracle Bot account as a default review author") changed that: develop has only `benchbox-oracle[bot]`, and _graphql_login adds `[bot]` only when GitHub reports a Bot account, so a human account named benchbox-oracle is not trusted.
- #2784 says a 300-file marker keeps its patch map; it keeps it only up to about 200 files (see oracle-marker-patch-map-file-limit-20261009).
Also, #2758's squash commit title on develop is "feat/oracle review cutover" (96c26ad3c), which reads as a branch name; a commit title cannot be changed, so the PR title is the only place to correct it.
